rationale: The mutate objective explicitly creates a missing endpoint.txt with one of two text values, and the only permitted output file is endpoint.txt. Eligible write_file directly performs that required operation. The visible Selector input does not reveal the trimmed mode value; that affects Executor content arguments, not whether a text-file write is appropriate. No endpoint value is chosen by this review and no staged selection is treated as an executed write.
